scope_statement: Step 9 validation before Rust translation; not production backend selection, complete simulator implementation, or broad process certification.

verdicts.R_review: authored_review_completed; no independent blanket R promotion

evidence_classes.name: artifact/trace integrity
evidence_classes.description: Hashes, unique IDs, owner alignment, and references only.

evidence_classes.name: authored adversarial walkthrough
evidence_classes.description: Scenario meaning/action/path review; not independent person or full formal proof.

evidence_classes.name: extracted upstream numerical body
evidence_classes.description: Pinned source body in isolated import context; not the complete package or its distributed build.

evidence_classes.name: authored numerical process/formulation scaffold
evidence_classes.description: Synthetic materials and host solver; can demonstrate contract algebra, not actual backend breadth or real-fluid accuracy.

evidence_classes.name: bounded sequential behavioral model
evidence_classes.description: Finite traces and negative controls; not production concurrency or native resource proof.

evidence_classes.name: complete installed provider/adapter
evidence_classes.description: Exact distribution and actual adapter surface, not achieved here.

evidence_classes.name: independent physical-reference validation
evidence_classes.description: Independent measured evidence with uncertainty and frozen tolerances, not achieved here.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Blending and splitting without reaction
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Two compatible feeds with declared component flows and a chosen pressure/heat rule; a separate composition-preserving splitter.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Capture each account; perform material and enthalpy-flow aggregation; resolve the mixed state; route a coherent product set.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: An arithmetic temperature average or a partial component edit masquerading as complete replacement changes input intent.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Actual material data, full reference simulator integration, and all GUI/API edit paths remain untested.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Sensible heating and heat exchange
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: A duty heater and a separately identified rating mode; complete calorics versus optional transport.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Freeze the actual enthalpy function before PH resolution; attach only the properties required by the selected unit mode.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Adding a missing caloric term after a partial PH solve gives the wrong target; missing rating viscosity cannot be hidden.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: No real-fluid heat duty or geometry/rating model validated.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Liquid pumping and pressure-loss calculations
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: A liquid account with pressure specification and a unit-owned pump or pipe relationship; density and viscosity demands explicit.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Bind a liquid-capable package; evaluate the supplied phase; let equipment supply pressure/work/hydraulic constraints.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Our zero-liquid-volume synthetic VLE fixture cannot be promoted to a physical pumping or pressure-loss model.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: A real density/viscosity package and pump/pipe law are mandatory outstanding fixtures.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Gas compression, expansion and intercooling
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Gas inlet, outlet pressure, efficiency law, PS reference and distinct actual PH outlet.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Compute the isentropic reference; apply the unit efficiency; resolve actual outlet energy; qualify both local and unit balances.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Publishing the ideal reference as the actual machine outlet or differentiating a frozen inner phase misses the intended problem.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Synthetic ideal material only; real compressor envelope, phase policy and provider behavior remain open.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Cooling and vapor–liquid separation
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: A cooled feed with a shared permitted vapor/liquid allocation and explicit product quantities.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Resolve one material equilibrium; check component/energy totals; then apply product routing.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: A numerical phase entry or report aggregate cannot create a product, and a converged local allocation cannot claim global stability.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: No actual-library flash dispatcher or real-mixture stability validation.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Pressure reduction with flashing
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Isenthalpic pressure-reducing unit with fixed original H, pressure, amount and nonreacting composition.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Capture original target; initialize and solve complete PH; recheck target; publish only the declared outlet completion kind.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: A root finder reporting success on a jump, a target rewritten to its returned value, or obsolete completion must be rejected.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Synthetic valve executed; production provider and downstream stream publication remain untested.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Conventional equilibrium-stage distillation
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Two or more named internal stages with shared method definitions and distinct local variables and completion scopes.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Use phase-only or equation contributions; retain initialization interventions; collect final stage/interstage residuals before parent acceptance.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: A stage at an old iterate may not join a newer inlet merely because the package revision matches.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: No rigorous multistage column executed; stage topology and all MESH equations remain a real-fixture gate.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Nonideal-liquid separation and azeotropic behavior
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: A liquid activity model, directed temperature-dependent interactions, compatible vapor and caloric definitions.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Resolve ordered parameters and their formulas; evaluate activities/caloric terms; only then qualify an assembled VLE/separation profile.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Transposed parameters can produce plausible gamma values; a matching kernel example does not establish azeotrope or distillation behavior.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Source numerical example reproduced; no complete ethanol-water VLE/azeotrope package or independent mixture data comparison.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Physical absorption, humidification and gas dissolution
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Gas and solvent with allowed physical partitioning, explicit dilute-solute standard, wet/dry reporting and no declared reaction.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Evaluate each phase and its partition relationships; apply unit transfer/energy balances; derive reports without changing physical amounts.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Missing Henry-law convention or gas-solvent data cannot be repaired by undeclared ideal partitioning.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Actual Henry/saturation/concentration conventions and process fixture still required.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Liquid–liquid extraction and decanting
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Two liquid instances with component amounts and a named correspondence/routing policy.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Solve a shared two-liquid problem; retain physical versus numerical entries; reconcile amounts and both activity conditions; route afterward.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Array reversal cannot swap physical meaning; symmetry and equal density do not supply unique continuous phase correspondence.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Artificial NRTL mixture; sampled common-tangent evidence is not a general global or empirical validation.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Vapor–liquid–liquid separation
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: One vapor and two candidate liquids in a single equilibrium description.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Declare all permitted domains, require compatible shared allocation and energy, and admit an actual three-phase numerical surface.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Two independent binary flashes or a two-phase-only adapter cannot satisfy simultaneous VLL by omission.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: No three-phase native or authored thermodynamic calculation executed; P2 delivery remains open.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Water and steam through saturation
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Pure water with subcooled, saturated and superheated requests, plus explicit phase-fraction basis.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Distinguish endpoint property query, dependent saturated TP inputs and fully specified allocation using another valid constraint.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: RR degeneracy alone must not condemn a PH problem whose energy equation determines quality; naive scalar TP bracketing can fail.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: No water backend imported; full-package water and quality workers blocked.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Pure-fluid refrigeration loop
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Closed pure-fluid refrigeration loop, with PS reference, actual compression energy, condenser, throttle and evaporator.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Reuse one coherent fluid convention through all unit states; verify cycle heat/work and loop completion separately.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: One successful compressor or PH call is not an executed refrigeration loop.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: No actual refrigerant cycle executed; component probes are only contributing evidence.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Mixed-refrigerant phase change
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: A true refrigerant mixture, or explicitly distinct pseudo-pure approximation, with fraction and endpoint conventions.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Keep vapor/liquid compositions distinct; qualify mixture inverse routes and temperature-glide reference evidence.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Pure-fluid Q semantics or a pseudo-pure surrogate cannot silently replace a specified mixture.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Synthetic binary only; actual blend data, glide and full cycle remain untested.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Assay-derived petroleum pseudocomponents
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: A retained source assay, explicit cuts, generated constituent identities, selected correlations and a data/package revision proposal.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Characterize in a provisional context; validate identities and full calorics; commit a consistent revision; save raw and derived evidence.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: PVT-only pseudocomponents cannot qualify heating; generated cuts alone are insufficient archive reconstruction.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: No accessible real assay characterized; native DWSIM path and alternative custom-data paths remain blocked/uninstantiated.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Black-oil or other reduced petroleum representation
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: A reduced oil/gas/water description with empirical standard conditions, supported correlations and declared absent molecular detail.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Preserve bulk representation meaning; use only available empirical state operations; translate across a separate boundary when justified.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Inventing a unique detailed composition to call a molecular flash violates material meaning.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: No black-oil runtime or reference case executed.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Specified-conversion reaction
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Balanced synthetic A to B with strict imposed extent and an explicit caloric reference treatment.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Check availability before transformation; retain reaction normalization; reconcile reaction/formation energy exactly once.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Clipping extent 1.2 to 1.0 with one mole A available answers a different problem.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Strict synthetic amount contract exercised; an actual reaction parameter set and unit package remain outstanding.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Chemical-equilibrium reaction
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: A coherent chemical system with conserved quantities, species participation and thermal constraints.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Use one combined problem; solve species/thermal unknowns through a condensed or exposed formulation; check final residuals together.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Fixed-species phase equilibrium is not chemical equilibrium; small inner errors or a later reflash cannot be ignored.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Authored ideal two-species reaction only; no Reaktoro/IDAES chemistry runtime or real database validation.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Kinetically controlled reaction
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: A finite-rate law with explicit volume/catalyst/site basis, frozen/equilibrated subsets and unit-owned residence-time context.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Provide local activities/concentrations and calorics without forcing forbidden equilibrium; distinguish rate from integrated extent.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Changing rate basis or replacing kinetics with equilibrium changes the declared physical model.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: No kinetic reactor integration or native kinetic/equilibrium coupling executed.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Reactive separation
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Reactive multistage or interphase separation with simultaneous chemistry, phase and thermal requirements.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Assemble one final coupled acceptance problem, including any declared sequential approximation and its reconciliation.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Adding isolated successes from an LLE test and a chemical-equilibrium test cannot certify a reactive separation.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Only separate contributing primitives exercised; complete coupled reactive separation remains open.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Electrolyte mixing and neutralization
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: One aqueous material account with apparent inputs, true ionic species, charge convention and reporting map.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Map conserved quantities without duplicate inventory; solve allowed chemistry; retain pH/activity and energy conventions.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: An apparent salt and its corresponding ions cannot both be summed as additional physical mass.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Inherited synthetic bookkeeping only; no real ionic system or neutralization energy evaluated.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Reactive gas absorption into aqueous liquid
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Gas/aqueous contacting with reaction, phase transfer, required calorics and any explicitly authorized reservoir.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Record every signed material/energy exchange once; combine chemistry and contactor constraints; distinguish equilibrium versus rate-based mode.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: A pH/fugacity constraint cannot silently add titrant/gas; a speciation-only answer is not an energy-balanced absorber.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Actual chemistry/transport/caloric compatibility and full absorber fixture absent.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Inert solids carried with fluid
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Disjoint fluid and inert-solid portions, with carried quantities, thermal data and explicit carryover rules.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Keep equilibrium-inactive solids in material balances; use their supported mass calorics; route mechanically at the unit boundary.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: A carried inert solid must not disappear during flash; an effective viscosity requires its own closure.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Mass-only thermal contribution exercised; a real slurry package and solids-routing fixture remain untested.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Crystallization and precipitation
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Solution with explicit permissible crystal/mineral identities and thermal conditions.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Qualify common solution/solid data and phase-onset meaning; check final conservation, chemical/phase conditions and declared stability scope.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: A saturation index alone is not crystal yield or size; zero-amount candidates do not become products.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: No crystallization/precipitation engine or kinetic/size model exercised.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Gas–solid chemical transformation
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Gas plus reactive solid and product forms with coherent thermochemistry and selected reaction/transport assumptions.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Keep solid identities and participation explicit; solve the selected equilibrium or rate problem and a complete energy account.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: A gas-phase isomerization fixture cannot validate heterogeneous solid behavior.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Only abstract coupled energy reasoning; actual gas-solid database, phases and unit closure remain open.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Rate-based nonequilibrium contacting
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Distinct bulk-phase and interface states, allowed temperature differences, flux conventions and mandatory transport properties.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Evaluate supplied phases without bulk re-equilibration; let the contactor own area/transfer relations; check coupled flux balances.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: An efficiency-corrected equilibrium-stage result cannot substitute for the full bulk/interface formulation.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Property-authority scaffold exercised; no full transfer or multi-component diffusion formulation executed.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Adsorption and membrane state extensions
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Separate bulk and site/surface accounts or membrane sides, loading denominator and explicitly supplied transfer.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Convert loading under its stated basis, form paired amount changes, preserve distinct account identity and limited numerical capability.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: An excess-loading convention cannot be silently treated as total stored amount; a surface is not an ordinary liquid.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Conceptual action route and inherited arithmetic reviewed; independent R review and numerical extension deferred.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Heat exchange between different property packages
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Two material regions with separate package conventions and no cross-wall material transfer.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Evaluate side energies, reconcile common heat duty, qualify and publish both sides as one intended group.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Independent absolute energy zeroes are allowed; mismatched group members or hidden component conversion are not.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Synthetic heat-coupling numerical fixture only; real independent packages and integrated lifecycle still untested.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Material transfer across a property-package boundary
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Source and target package bindings, identity map, known reference transform and chosen preserved quantities.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Apply mapping/reference conversion, resolve target under admissible constraints, report residual model disagreement separately from actual heat.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Holding incompatible corrected H and T simultaneously by hidden duty must fail.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Inherited reference algebra rerun; no cross-native-package material boundary executed.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Translation between material representations
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Explicit directed representation map with preserved quantities, loss and any additional inverse assumptions.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Map one account into a non-additive view or target boundary; record what is lost; reject unsupported unique reconstruction.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: A lump or apparent view does not contain sufficient information for an automatic unique reverse map.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Directed semantic walkthrough and inherited algebra only; profile-specific chemical/assay mappings not exercised.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Mass-based empirical and nonconventional materials
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Mass-based empirical constituent with actual mass flow, a complete stated h(T) and no molecular-weight assertion.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Run the supported mass-energy operation; reject molecular operations needing unavailable data without discarding thermal usefulness.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: No invented molecular weight or fake critical point is admitted to satisfy a fluid API.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Thermal synthetic fixture executed; no field material correlation or empirical transport validation.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Polymer distributions and material attributes
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Distribution support, mass/number weighting, retained attributes and explicit reduction lineage.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Associate distribution with material quantity; combine compatible weighted distributions; record losses when reducing moments.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: One mean is not a lossless full distribution and cannot generate a unique detailed inverse.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Conceptual route and inherited weighted arithmetic; P3 numerical thermodynamics remains deferred.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Inventory-based state and dynamic compatibility
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Actual inventory composition/amounts and total U,V with location/time meaning, including a separately empty case.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Capture unresolved T,P as outputs without dummy flow; distinguish inventory from a numerical reference amount.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: Total U,V without justified material amount does not uniquely specify a fluid state.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Representability walkthrough only; no native inventory solve or time integration claimed.

scenario_walkthroughs.title: Restricted-equilibrium and metastable-state requests
scenario_walkthroughs.specified_input_case: Declared excluded phases/reactions or requested metastable branch, rationale, candidate scope and reference to original unrestricted question.
scenario_walkthroughs.semantic_and_action_route: Create a distinct restricted problem; qualify the limited claim; lifting restrictions invalidates applicability to the new problem.
scenario_walkthroughs.adversarial_condition: A branch seed is not a physical restriction, and constrained success is not unrestricted stable equilibrium.
scenario_walkthroughs.remaining_gate: Degeneracy controls only; metastable/phase-restricted native operations remain deferred.
